ec-3DE7.title: Guardrail: double guardrails
ec-3DE7.summary: Roads often have two stacked metal guardrails. This is much less common in other South American countries.

ec-4Cwf.title: Plants: banana plantations
ec-4Cwf.summary: Banana plants and big plantations are mostly found in the southwest.

ec-4F5m.title: Kilometre marker: green with highway shield
ec-4F5m.summary: Green kilometre markers carry the national highway shield.

ec-6GsD.title: Guardrail: black and yellow painted
ec-6GsD.summary: Guardrails painted black and yellow, instead of plain silver or solid yellow, point to the province around the big southwestern port city, Guayas.

ec-7DsW.title: Road: divided highway in dry coast area
ec-7DsW.summary: A divided highway (the E-40 between Salinas and Guayaquil) is one of the few in the country, and the only one in the dry southwest coast.

ec-7ek9.title: Coverage: mostly the west, gaps in the Amazon
ec-7ek9.summary: Most coverage is in the western part. Much of the Amazon has none. The Galapagos Islands have some backpack coverage.

ec-8VeO.title: Google car: white pickup, black trunk
ec-8VeO.summary: The newer Gen 4 car is a white pickup truck with a black cover on the bed and no antenna. Panama and Costa Rica pickups have an antenna at the front.

differs.how: Pickup has an antenna on the front
Pickup has an antenna on the front

ec-8Xg1.title: Plate: white, mix of short and long
ec-8Xg1.summary: Standard plates are white and come in both short and long sizes, often mixed together. Taxis and buses have orange plates or an orange bar on top. No other Latin American country mixes sizes.

ec-8XgY.title: Road: concrete road surface
ec-8XgY.summary: Roads made of concrete slabs are fairly common.

ec-CduU.title: Camera: low-quality Ari with wide blur
ec-CduU.summary: A low-quality camera with a wide round car blur and brownish colours. You sometimes see a red logo at the front. No other Latin American country has this camera.

ec-F7Tj.title: Sign: one-way and two-way arrows
ec-F7Tj.summary: Street direction signs have the text written inside an arrow. In Latin America only the Dominican Republic and Puerto Rico use similar signs.

ec-H10J.title: Plate: taxi first letter shows the province
ec-H10J.summary: Taxis are common, and the first letter on the plate usually matches the province name's first letter. The same letter starts normal plates. P, for the Quito area, shows up in many regions.

ec-HsDH.title: Google car: white car, short stubby antenna
ec-HsDH.summary: The older Gen 3 car is white with a short, thick antenna, though car or antenna may be hidden. Mexico, Brazil and Colombia can show the same antenna.

ec-LwpU.title: Sign: square white road signs
ec-LwpU.summary: Many road signs are square with a white background, in the design shown in the image.

ec-N2lV.title: Coverage: islands with backpack and boat only
ec-N2lV.summary: The Galapagos Islands, west of the mainland, only have backpack and boat coverage. Landscapes range from volcanic soil and low shrubs to craters, sometimes with giant tortoises.

ec-QajZ.title: Pole: concrete with oval see-through holes
ec-QajZ.summary: Electricity poles with oval holes through them are most common in the southern province of Loja, and sometimes found in neighbouring provinces.

ec-T07k.title: Landscape: Amazon look but hilly
ec-T07k.summary: A rainforest look similar to the Amazon, but much hillier, points to the northwest coast province of Esmeraldas.

ec-Z3gQ.title: Roadside: brown pipe along the road
ec-Z3gQ.summary: A brown pipe runs alongside a few roads in the north-east.

ec-blv0.title: Vegetation: dry land with many pines
ec-blv0.summary: A semi-dry area with lots of pine trees points to the province of Chimborazo in the central mountains.

ec-cF1l.title: Bollard: round red stripes or flat black panel
ec-cF1l.summary: Bollards are very common here. One is round with two red stripes, the other flat with two red reflectors on black. Malaysia can have a similar flat one.

differs.how: Sometimes has a similar rectangular bollard

ec-dewU.title: Landscape: very flat land
ec-dewU.summary: The flattest area is around the big southwestern port city, easiest to see on the E-25 and E-48 roads. The Amazon area is flat too.

ec-g3pY.title: Landscape: Andes in the middle
ec-g3pY.summary: The Andes mountains run through the middle of the country, while the east and the west are flatter.

ec-g9O5.title: Google car: high or low antenna wire
ec-g9O5.summary: The antenna comes in two types. On the high one, the wire is all above the halfway line. On the low one, most wire is below it. A high antenna always means the northern half.

ec-iFnv.title: Vegetation: white-barked trees and oil palms
ec-iFnv.summary: A flat area with many white-barked trees and oil palms is the Amazon. Almost all of its coverage uses the rarer high antenna.

ec-iKkh.title: Landscape: winding mountain roads
ec-iKkh.summary: In the south, mountain roads wind through exposed reddish-brown soil. The central provinces have similar roads, but usually without the bare dirt.

ec-ifrx.title: Pavement: hexagonal tiles
ec-ifrx.summary: In towns you sometimes see pavement made of hexagon-shaped tiles.

ec-ki46.title: Pole: concrete with ladder-like indents
ec-ki46.summary: Most poles are plain round concrete, not very helpful. The useful one is the ladder pole, with many small indents like rungs. Brazil's waffle poles have far fewer indents.

differs.how: Waffle poles have only a couple of indents

ec-lm-123.title: Camera: low-quality Ari in South America
ec-lm-123.summary: If you see this low-quality camera in South America, it is Ecuador, which is the only country there with it. Ecuador also has Gen 3 and some Gen 4, so don't rule it out when the camera looks normal.

ec-lm-871.title: Road: grey, dirty coastal road with a beach
ec-lm-871.summary: One road on the southern east coast looks like a grey, dirty version of the nearby northern Peru coast, with more garbage. A side road leads to a pretty beach.

ec-ohfM.title: Landscape: very dry coast
ec-ohfM.summary: A very dry, bare landscape found only on the coast between Guayaquil and Manta.

ec-r9a6.title: Houses: grey bricks and metal roofs
ec-r9a6.summary: Most houses are grey brick with metal roofs. This is common but not unique. Peru and especially Bolivia use more red bricks.

ec-rhiO.title: Sign back: teal blue paint
ec-rhiO.summary: The back of signs is sometimes painted teal blue, on thin metal posts. No other Latin American country does this.

ec-vWms.title: Google car: Gen 4 across most of the country
ec-vWms.summary: The newer Gen 4 coverage is found in most of the country, with gaps in the northwest and southeast.

ec-ynOS.title: Chevron: many chevrons in each curve
ec-ynOS.summary: Curves have far more chevron signs than in most Latin American countries. Colombia also sometimes uses many.
